text:
Rasmus Dahlin scored 17 seconds into Wednesday's game against the Rangers, and Buffalo went on to win 5-1. After the game, a Sabres video carried his line: "We Are A Good Team And Eventually It Is Going To Click." The Sabres have won three of their last four, so maybe it is starting to.

Dahlin is still the engine. He plays more than 24 minutes a night, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 99th percentile among defensemen last season in primary shot assists, with more than half his exits leaving the zone with possession. Evolving-Hockey rated him 12th of 215 defensemen.

This season has been quieter than his standard. He has 17 points in 22 games, a pace below last season's 74, and his points per 60 sit at the bottom of his likely range. The chances with him on the ice are fine (the Sabres get about 52% of five-on-five expected goals with him out there), so this looks more like a team still finding its finish than a player in decline. If Buffalo's click arrives, he will be at the middle of it.
